title: Grandpa Is Nine Feet TALL 📏
description:
In our town, every time you say you're proud of someone, you grow an inch. Bragging dads duck under every door.

My grandpa runs the hardware store, says about ten words a day, and has never once said it to me. He's nine feet tall and still growing.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment INCH if you'd have said it first.
